svg.title: DeepResearch Bench I / FACT citation accuracy
svg.desc: Every sourced observation, grouped by cohort and reasoning effort. Solid independent, hatched vendor-hosted; black lines are score confidence intervals.

g.text: DeepResearch Bench I / FACT citation accuracy
Raw percent; higher is better. Efforts and scaffolds are separate.
Solid: independent. Hatched: self-reported/vendor-hosted. CI: source score interval. No rank intervals.
No verified observations for retained models. Missing is not zero.
